description: The file defines the TestCluster class used for deploying, managing, and testing Orleans clusters within a testing environment. It provides methods to start/stop silos, initialize clients, and manage cluster configurations for unit tests and integration tests.

classes.name: TestCluster
classes.description: A class for hosting and managing an Orleans testing cluster, with support for starting/stopping silos, client initialization, and cluster configuration.

methods.name: DefaultCreateSiloAsync
methods.description: Creates a default in-process silo handle with configurations based on cluster options and transport type.

methods.name: StartSiloAsync
methods.description: Starts a new silo instance asynchronously using specified configuration.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops a given silo handle gracefully or immediately.

methods.name: StopSilosAsync
methods.description: Stops all silos in the cluster asynchronously.

methods.name: InitializeClientAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Orleans client for testing, setting up endpoints and transport options.
